concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-users-roles-log-in-with-paypal]] - PayPal-credential login for separate Braintree Sandbox or Production accounts, with Braintree-credential and 2FA transition warnings and an explicit boundary from PayPal payment-method setup
warnings: Keep this route under Braintree Control Panel account access; do not conflate it with the standalone PayPal Log in with PayPal identity product or the Braintree PayPal gateway payment integration.
Preserve that PayPal and Braintree remain separate accounts and that PayPal payment acceptance requires separate configuration.
Do not infer that the same user identity, role, permissions or environment data transfers between Sandbox and Production merely because both login destinations are named.
Treat the separately linked PayPal payment-method setup guide and API-user guidance as navigation only unless each authority is fully read for a retained claim.
